items.reason: The retinol 1% night serum is the one retinoid kept, for the fine-line and texture goals you asked about.
Your scan shows low moisture, so a ceramide moisturizer helps cushion the skin while a strong retinol settles in.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a mineral SPF 50 is needed each morning.

response.routine_note: I left out the Retinal Firming Eye Cream because using two retinoids together often causes dryness and irritation, so choose one at a time. Use the retinol at night, starting 2 nights a week, build up slowly, and wear the SPF every morning.
